integrity: A standalone exact-rational checker supplements a self-contained analytical proof; verification is mathematical and self-review only, not independent certification.
limitations: Regular interior fibers only for all-degree saturation; degree-two rigidity assumes two distinct sampling points; no higher-degree off-fiber, critical-fiber, or repeated-jet classification. Novelty can require independent historical verification.
title: Interior full-fiber saturation and two-point rigidity for finite Blaschke Schwarz–Pick matrices
